description: Known ontology drift, burned down over time. scripts/quality/check-ontology.mjs reconciles this bidirectionally: unlisted findings fail CI, stale entries fail CI once the drift is fixed, and entries expire at most 250 days out. Renew an entry consciously with a fresh note — never let one roll silently.

entries.subject: vocab:capital/rep:capital-type
entries.detail: order expected [social, material, financial, living, intellectual, experiential, spiritual, cultural] found [living, social, material, financial, intellectual, experiential, spiritual, cultural]
entries.note: Reorder CapitalType to the canonical machine order, or land the Capital-to-CapitalType mapping function first — index-based bridges between the two lists are unsafe until one of those happens.

entries.subject: vocab:signal-pool-type/rep:indexer
entries.note: Dead surface: the GraphQL PoolType enum is referenced by zero entity fields and its only consumer (mapPoolType/POOL_TYPE_MAP) is locked in by its own test. Fix or delete alongside the shared enum flip.

entries.subject: vocab:signal-pool-type/rep:shared
entries.note: Inverted vs the Solidity enum but verified latent, not live: pool types are assigned by address identity (annotateGardenSignalPools), never decoded from a raw uint8. Flipping touches ~20 find() call sites, fixtures, stories, and i18n keys — re-verify blast radius at burn-down.

entries.subject: vocab:work-display-status/rep:enhanced-work-approval
entries.note: Consolidate EnhancedWorkApproval.status onto the canonical WorkDisplayStatus union during the work-status consolidation.

entries.subject: vocab:work-display-status/rep:offline-work-item

entries.subject: vocab:work-display-status/rep:hypercert-sync-status

entries.note: Consolidate HypercertSyncStatus onto WorkDisplayStatus or a declared sync-subset during the work-status consolidation.

entries.subject: vocab:domain/mapping:action-domain-vs-slug-prefix
entries.detail: only in action-domain: [agroforestry, education]; only in slug-prefix: [agro, edu]
entries.note: Two lowercase spellings of the same domains. On-chain action slugs are immutable, so expect the ActionDomain union to converge toward the slug prefixes (or an explicit map) during Domain vocabulary unification.

entries.subject: watch:action-domains-collision
entries.note: Rename the module-local numeric ACTION_DOMAINS in useActionForm (or reuse an exported domain-values constant) so the identifier no longer collides with the exported string vocabulary.

entries.subject: watch:parsedomain-unknown-coercion
entries.note: Make parseDomain surface unknown indexer domains (null/undefined) instead of silently coercing them to Domain.SOLAR, and update consumers to handle the unknown branch.
